Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problems (DVRP) are a class of problems where vehicles have to visit a set of customers in a minimum amount of time while respecting some constraints (capacity, time windows).
we have designed a dynamic vehicle routing problem under flexible time windows and fuzzy travel times, which allows us to solve the problem in real-time.
The dynamic vehicle routing problems with time windows and fuzzy travel times are solved by a dynamic algorithm that takes into account two indicators qualifying the service level.

the design of a dynamic vehicle routing problem with time windows and fuzzy travel times.
the design of a decision aid tool, allowing a decision maker to solve a dynamic routing problem in a context where travel times and time window are subject to uncertainties.
the dynamic management of the fleet of vehicles in a context of uncertainty.
